purpose: Reduce the review/search surface dominated by repetitive or low-signal pages while preserving URLs, diagnostic tools, and all observed Search Console clicks.
principles: Held URLs remain accessible and followable; they are not deleted or redirected.
All Search Console clicks in the supplied 28-day export are protected.
Primary article directories, RSS, sitemap and site-search indexes expose only the curated indexable surface.
Repeated four-axis boilerplate is removed site-wide rather than merely hidden from indexing.
Ad serving remains disabled until actual AdSense approval.
